metadata.title: [BUG]: UI shows mcp server "offline" while Test succeeds.
metadata.author: jwoehr

description: ### 🐞 Bug Summary UI "MCP Servers & Federated Gateways (MCP Registry)" shows mcp server status "Offline" with flyover "Gateway not reachable" while Test feature of same page for same mcp server succeeds. --- ### 🧩 Affected Component Select the area of the project impacted: - [ ] `mcpgateway` - API - [ x] `mcpgateway` - UI (admin panel) - [ ] `mcpgateway.wrapper` - stdio wrapper - [ ] Federation or Transports - [ ] CLI, Makefiles, or shell scripts - [ ] Container setup (Docker/Podman/Compose) - [ ] Other (explain below) --- ### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce 1. Install ibmi-mcp-server 2. UI shows offline 3. Click the Test action --- ### 🤔 Expected Behavior When server is active, UI should not show offline --- ### 📓 Logs / Error Output Paste any relevant stack traces or logs here. ⚠️ **Do not paste secrets, credentials, or tokens.** --- ### 🧠 Environment Info You can retrieve most of this from the `/version` endpoint. | Key | Value | |-----|-------| | Version or commit | v0.9.0 | | Runtime | Python 3.12.3 | | Platform / OS | Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS | | Container | none | --- ### 🧩 Additional Context (optional) Add any configuration details, flags, or related issues.
